browser: Codex In-app Browser 2; actual rendered SVG and editor UI
observations: Transformer local actual-SVG comparison shows three projections and their following helper stages in corresponding columns. Group order derives from existing consumer edges; labels do not trigger layout.

Transformer whole role view remains 105 nodes and 111 edges on 2588 x 5568 pixels. Crossings 65 to 60 and wire length 87508.6 to 84020.3. Three groups and three exact projection constraints are route-verified.

Unfamiliar woven input graph has three aligned heterogeneous two-stage paths with independent inputs and an extra short path. No family certificate exists. Its candidate is accepted against the new frame policy.

Interrupted graph retains the unresolved call and its source wrapper. Automatic column candidate is rejected: wire 3442.2 to 4306.8 exceeds the 10 percent budget despite crossings 3 to 1. Explicit experiment preserves two known paths and the unknown boundary; it is not an automatic success.

Frozen-to-current comparisons are distinct from candidate comparisons. Removing presentation rank bands changes woven crossings 0 to 2 and interrupted 0 to 3, while reducing their canvas area. Crossings are not claimed globally nonregressing.

Nine of ten paired existing mixed evaluation SVGs remain byte-identical. InterruptedMixer changes 28 to 26 nodes by attaching rank frames, keeps 26 edges and reduces crossings 7 to 6. SameSource also loses a rank frame outside that paired set.

Actual mixed UI preserves 29 to 33 to 29 nodes through expansion, save, reopen and refold. Gate * signal source and independently proved local relations are inspectable. Exported mixed and woven SVGs match independent rendering.
Final implementation was reloaded in the editor and reopening the saved mixed intermediate frontier reproduces the exact original exported SVG.

Thirty-two final browser SVG panels pass node and port text bounding-rectangle checks, including circular operator glyphs and path-shaped control nodes. Independent XML/path audit separately verifies crossings, boundaries, ports, column geometry and canonical accounting.
limitations: Reference correspondence of semantic boundaries and roles remains unverified. Local improvements do not establish an intermediate frontier equivalent to the dedicated diagram.
Overall composition remains tall and staggered, with many long inter-region routes. Nine of twelve context channels and fifteen of eighteen projection constraints remain deferred.
The new presentation-frame policy can increase crossings against the frozen baseline; further layout selection should evaluate this tradeoff rather than relying solely on the column candidate budget.
The manually deeper mixed view retains one port-label-requires-note issue.
Automatic evaluation is bounded to role canvas views with at most 128 edges; extra projection and candidate render work still needs responsiveness measurement.
Graph-wide adaptive expression selection, held-out mixed composition and cross-language numeric digest/export contracts remain unfinished.
